fields.topology_type: Point-to-point asynchronous serial (TX → peer RX, RX ← peer TX) with optional 6-wire modem handshake.

supported_topologies.name: Two-wire point-to-point
supported_topologies.description: SOUT ↔ SIN cross-connected between two UARTs; common ground reference; no clock wire.

supported_topologies.name: Modem (DTE-DCE) link
supported_topologies.description: Full RS-232 link via external line driver: 2 data + 6 modem handshake (CTS/RTS/DSR/DTR/DCD/RI).

supported_topologies.name: RS-485 multi-drop
supported_topologies.description: External RS-485 transceiver with direction enabled by RTS or OUT1/OUT2; multi-node half-duplex.

supported_topologies.name: TTL-level loopback
supported_topologies.description: MCR.LOOP=1; internal SOUT→SIN; modem outputs drive modem inputs; for chip-level diagnostic.

master_slave_role_summary.description: A UART acting as the data source/sink (e.g. PC); drives DTR + RTS; receives DSR / CTS / DCD / RI from DCE.
A modem or peer; drives DSR / CTS / DCD / RI; receives DTR + RTS from DTE.
Two UARTs back-to-back with crossed TX/RX + crossed RTS/CTS + crossed DTR/DSR/DCD.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router). The UART is one endpoint of a 2-wire async serial link; routing/switching happens at the application layer (e.g. modem dial-up) or via external multiplexers.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_byte: Bits transmitted LSB-first; receiver reassembles in same order.
ordering_guarantees.across_bytes: Strictly in software-issue order (no reordering); TX FIFO is FIFO; RX FIFO is FIFO.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — UART is one peripheral; its 8 register slots live in the SoC's I/O space.

slave_classification.polling_target: Software polls LSR.DR / THRE for non-interrupt-driven operation.
slave_classification.interrupt_target: INTR signal drives external interrupt controller; software services via IIR-identified source.
slave_classification.dma_target: TXRDY/RXRDY drive an external DMA controller for high-throughput data movement.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: Table I — Reset Configuration of the UART

modem_control_topology.active_polarity: All modem control signals are active LOW at the modem interface.
